body.x: NAMUTECH (CEO Chul Jung) is joining the top technology leaders at CES 2023, the most influential tech event in the world, from the 5th to the 8th of January in Las Vegas to unveil the cloud-unified digital transformation solution, 'Smart DX Solution.'
At CES 2023, NAMUTECH showcased 'Smart DX Solution,' where visitors can experience firsthand the integrated service operation and monitoring features of the next-generation cloud services.

'Smart DX Solution' is the first solution that provides a unified management environment for cloud services, including the IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS. It supports a multi/hybrid cloud environment and provides web GUI-based user convenience and detailed monitoring from infrastructure to application.

Smart DX Solution integrates IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS to provide an integrated management platform (CMP) that manages, monitors, and views services, providing cloud users with safe and convenient infrastructure, platform, and application management functions.

Container-based Smart DX includes OpenStack (IaaS) which creates VMs, Docker which creates containers, and Kubernetes (PaaS) which orchestrates containers, and can integrate and manage various open-source and Kubernetes clusters through automation.

With the Smart DX Solution, IT developers and administrators can increase agility by automating application installation, deployment, and operation. It helps to quickly analyze problems and issues in the field and take action to maintain stable service.

Smart DX Solution is suitable for adopting virtualization and cloud, Micro Service Architecture (MSA), and automation. It fundamentally improves the role of technology in integrated management and multiple areas of business. Smart DX Solution is the optimal solution to improve and change your work continuously.

An official from Namutech said, "Currently, cloud services (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) are different for each service due to different vendors, platforms, and solutions which makes it difficult for customers to operate and maintain them. It is difficult to determine the cause of a problem and requires a lot of time and effort to solve the issue." "Accordingly, NAMUTECH developed the Smart DX Solution to provide a unified management solution that can integrate and manage cloud services and track and manage correlation between services to easily identify the cause of the problem," he added.
